headline: Two teams slip out of ARC-3 gold

sections.text: _hans fell from 17th to 19th, while Lord Han Solo moved from 18th to 20th; both scores were unchanged.
The 18th-place gold line rose 0.14 in the past day to 37.12, putting both teams outside the 18 available gold places.
